notes.title: SteamOS & Linux Patch
notes.notes:
Hi all!

This is is a thing I thought I'd fixed some time ago but turns out it never got published. Oops. 

So from now on when you try to launch the game on Steam Deck or Linux, you won't get a missing executable error. I've also set what I hope are more useable default controller configs. Mouse Only seems to work fine!

Thank you for your (extreme) patience.

notes.title: The Aye Fair Lady Update
notes.notes:
We did it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30767507/4719bebf6ef37446700490c472b04d2eb3c8e7c5.jpg

It's been too long, but thanks to the supporters I've finally been able to ship a long awaited big update to Yorkshire Gubbins.

Aye Fair Lady has been added, the musical episode, as well as every episode being updated to run on the Aye Fair Lady version of the engine. In effect this is a huge graphics & ui overhaul for every episode, but Verb School has had a bit more love with refreshed art assets. 

I've also added keyboard shortcuts for the verbs, the most requested feature. 

Another big improvement is the ability to swap between episodes without abandoning your progress. Good for if you're stuck and want to play something else, I hope.

Speaking of hope, work will now be beginning on a brand new Gubbins episode. Progress will be slow as I have a full time job now, but I'm very confident the development is sustainable. And that's good news.

I hope you enjoy the refreshed Yorkshire Gubbins, and thank you for all your support!

notes.title: 1.0.4.2 - The Steggyvision Patch
notes.notes: This patch fixes an issue with low-end GPUs that weren't able to render Steggyvision at all. These GPUs won't have quite the same Steggyvision Quality Index (SQI) as those that already had it working, but it's better than nowt!

notes.title: Update: 1.0.4: Linux! Dialog skipping!
notes.notes:
Hello you!

1.0.4 brings two big features some some little things. The big things:

Linux / SteamOS Support!

We were always planning to support Linux but last minute technical issues meant our Linux build wasn't quite up to the standard expected, so it's been a little delayed. We hope you enjoy!

Skip dialog 

Only applies to dialogue you've heard before, but right clicking will end the current line immediately. This'll make accidentally repeating something a little less painful.

This version also fixes a number of little bugs and typos, including the ability to unlock the final 2 achievements. But you didn't hear that from us.
